scenarios.name: Replace the available-command selection with a secondary click

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
"2D Sketches" is selected in the available commands list
the user right-clicks "3D Annotations" in the available commands list
"3D Annotations" is highlighted instead of "2D Sketches"
the Part Tools target remains empty
